ladder.C0: Announcement or intention only. No verifiable material commitment.
ladder.C1: Site identified, land option, grid-connection request or preliminary step.
ladder.C2: Advanced project: secured site and/or significant permits and/or identifiable grid-connection or procurement agreement.
ladder.C3: Economic commitment: FID, firm financing, binding contract or irreversible material spending.
ladder.C4: Physical construction or installation effectively started.
ladder.X: Cancelled, abandoned or commitment materially withdrawn. Never erases the project history.
ladder.UNKNOWN: Project known to exist but evidence insufficient to assign C0-C5.

ladder_rules: A project moves up a level only with evidence matching that level's criterion, never on a general sponsor statement.
Every level change is a new observation; earlier states stay in the PIT history.

effective.definition: Capacity physically usable for AI compute, limited by the binding link whose availability is documented.
effective.rule_v0_1: C5 operational capacity, plus C3/C4 capacity whose critical dependencies are documented for the vintage considered. Only the canonical unit is summed; GPU, HBM, network or power quantities are never converted into it. If nothing can be summed, effective is null, never estimated.

C.name: Supply Commitment
C.from: commitment ladder (raw GW per level, committed = C3+C4+C5, operational = C5)

T.name: Time-to-Supply
T.from: project commitment and commissioning dates; expected GW per vintage

null_when: several demand series for the same scenario/year without a declared reference
absorption_stress.reading: AS < 1: estimated demand can absorb the capacity in this scenario. AS > 1: capacity exceeds estimated demand in this scenario. A stress ratio, not a crash indicator.

depreciation.method: full retirement at the end of expected useful life
depreciation.unknown_life: capacity is kept and reported separately as depreciation_unknown_gw
